dimensions.note: No credentials are accepted or used; strict schemas plus recursive bounded denylist reject credential and identifying patterns before persistence.
Structured entry, recorded, and idempotent-replay logs contain only validated snapshot IDs.
Malformed, cyclic, stale, inconsistent, leaked, and conflicting inputs fail before writes with deterministic diagnostics.
Eight tests cover success, strict leakage denial, credentials, URLs, IPs, sensitivity, freshness, attestation consistency, cyclic input, idempotent replay, tamper conflict, and zero authority.
Existing identical snapshots return without writing; same-ID content conflicts fail closed.
The provider-neutral model makes no external API calls.
The model opens no network connections, files, processes, or external resources.
README and fixtures contain synthetic provider-neutral identifiers only.
The persisted resource and every nested object are strict; row, byte, window, evidence, grouping, text, and traversal bounds are enforced.
The sole snapshot resource declares a 30-day lifetime and garbageCollection 10.
This is an immutable persistence-only validator, not a CRUD lifecycle integration.
There is no external mutation; validation and replay conflict detection run before the sole local write.
The sole writer deterministically uses snapshot-<validated snapshotId>; replay uses the identical name.
Replay detection uses context.readResource and never accesses the data repository directly.
This is the initial standalone publication version.
